rdfs:label: DirectContainer
rdfs:comment: An LDP Container that, on each new member, adds a membership triple linking a configurable `ldp:membershipResource` to the new resource via `ldp:hasMemberRelation` (or the inverse via `ldp:isMemberOfRelation`).
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Container`. Use when membership of new resources should be reflected on a *different* resource — e.g. a comments container whose POSTs add triples to the parent article. Carries `ldp:membershipResource` and `ldp:hasMemberRelation` to define the relation. Most Solid pods use `urn:solid:BasicContainer` instead. Not required by the Solid Protocol; most Solid servers support only BasicContainer.
